in_context.system_prompt:
Earlier, the user told you the following, one message at a time, oldest first:
1. "My dog is named Luna."
2. "My cat's eyes are green."
3. "The boat's colour is blue."
4. "The tent belongs to me."
5. "I like chocolate."
6. "My dog has grey eyes."
7. "My cat's eyes are the same colour as mine."
8. "My car's colour is red."
9. "The boat belongs to my sister."
10. "The colour of my eyes is green."
11. "The colour of my brother's eyes is amber."
12. "I really like cheese."
13. "My dog is called Bruno now."
14. "My sister lives in Turku."
15. "My sister's name is Ana."
16. "My brother's name is Otto."
17. "Of all colours, I like yellow the most."
18. "The boat has a new owner: my brother."
19. "My dog really likes apples."
20. "I am living in Porto."
21. "I have moved; I live in Lisbon now."
22. "My cat's name is Milo."
23. "My sister likes orange best."
24. "The tent is yellow."
25. "My sister has brown eyes."
26. "My favourite colour is blue now."
27. "My brother lives in the same city as my sister."
28. "I like pears."
29. "I no longer like cheese."
In these messages, "I", "me" and "my" mean the user.

reference.gap_is: in_context pass rate minus pocket pass rate, over the answers the pocket and every reference of the phase have; positive: the pocket is behind the model told in context

in_context.served: the untaught model, lessons in the system prompt

notes.served: the untaught model, each question's notes in the system prompt
